samples.context: C:North Wall, behind stacked rock wall
C:West 5h, beneath Blockage 12 at 1 m by bedrock

findings.assertion: 2009 charcoal Beta 266127 came from tepetate over Rock 3 in C:East (1730 ± 40 BP, 230–410 CE 2sigma), whereas Beta 266128 came from behind the C:North stacked rock wall (1760 ± 40 BP, 140–390 CE 2sigma); neither directly fixes the calendar year the wall was built.

Two 2009 charcoal tests in deep C:West fill near Blockage 12 are Beta 266129 in Layer 5d (1810 ± 40 BP, 120–260 and 280–330 CE 2sigma) and Beta 266130 in Layer 5h (1700 ± 40 BP, 240–420 CE 2sigma). These later-than-expected dates admit several depositional explanations; attribution to cave termination remains Sload's interpretation.

issues.note: Sload 2015 reports Beta 266130 model agreement 57.2; Sload 2020 reports 57.7, both near/below threshold 60; no lab certificates checked.
Calibrated charcoal age does not by itself prove when the cave walls or blockages were built.
Sload 2007, 2015, 2020 reports overlap in same excavation data and must not be counted as independent corroboration.
Sugiyama et al. 2013 radiocarbon tables uninspected. Original Millon et al. 1965 PDF available via Zenodo but 18.8 MB exceeds parser and container network is disabled.
